verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's own README and docs say it crawls an entire website, recursively, and returns content from every page. The webhook docs show crawl runs as an async job whose start, progress and finish are reported, which fits a single crawl request. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on crawl parameters and limits (depth, page caps, include/exclude rules), explicit evidence of one-request semantics versus async polling, and independent hands-on corroboration of whole-site crawls at scale.
